articles.title: UN Food Agency Cuts Gaza Aid by One-Third Amid Funding Shortages
articles.summary: The World Food Programme announced earlier this week that it is reducing food assistance to Gaza by approximately one-third, a move the UN agency attributed to funding shortages that will leave about half a million people without access to critical aid [1][2]…

articles.title: Israel raids towns, detains dozens of Palestinians in occupied West Bank
articles.summary: Israeli military raid targets at least 15 towns in the northern West Bank, including Nablus and Jenin.

articles.title: Syrian migrant walked free after raping teen in Germany – media
articles.summary: A Syrian migrant arrested on suspicion of raping a teenage girl was released from pre-trial detention after 40 days and later accused of another rape, German media has reported

articles.title: Amish woman uses weed whacker to scare off illegal migrant allegedly threatening to kidnap her at knifepoint
articles.summary: An Amish woman in Pennsylvania used a weed whacker to scare off an armed illegal migrant allegedly trying to kidnap her.
